categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electric power complete equipment manufacturing, new energy storage and charging devices, and new energy power generation projects. Key segments include power distribution equipment, anti-theft electric energy metering devices, installation and construction services, energy storage and charging devices, and photovoltaic power generation. It also engages in EPC engineering contracting and hydrogen fuel cell system development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include integrated primary and secondary power distribution equipment, power quality improvement devices such as DCC, APF, and SVG, and advanced charging pile technology with dynamic power distribution. The company emphasizes R&D in high-break capacity gas-insulated circuit breakers, containerized battery energy storage systems, and high-efficiency anion membrane water electrolysis for hydrogen production. Manufacturing involves complete in-house R&D, design, production, and sales with a focus on intelligent grid and energy storage solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major state-owned power grid companies including State Grid Corporation, Southern Power Grid, the five major power generation groups, local power companies, railways, industrial and mining enterprises, and new energy vehicle charging station operators. The company serves the electric power industry, new energy sector, and emerging markets such as smart microgrids and hydrogen fuel cell applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in East China, North China, and other regions. It has subsidiaries and projects across multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Shanghai, Anhui, Tianjin, Chongqing, and others. The geographic focus is domestic with expansion in economically developed areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric power and new energy supply chain. It manufactures and supplies power distribution and control equipment, energy storage and charging devices, and provides EPC contracting and operation services for photovoltaic and charging infrastructure projects.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in intelligent power distribution equipment, energy storage and charging integration, and hydrogen fuel cell systems. The company focuses on innovation in high-voltage insulation, large-capacity energy storage, and efficient hydrogen production technologies. It aims to enhance product competitiveness, expand market share in smart grids and new energy vehicles, and develop new energy integrated solutions aligned with national carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power equipment, energy storage and charging devices, and EPC contracting services. Additional income comes from photovoltaic power generation operations, government subsidies, and leasing income from investment properties. The company uses direct sales and channel distribution models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the mature electric power equipment and new energy sectors, facing intense competition especially in traditional power equipment. It leverages its technological advantages, integrated solutions, and strategic shareholder resources to maintain a stable market share. Major competitors include other domestic power equipment manufacturers and new energy solution providers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 428 million, a 26.52% increase year-over-year, but reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 27 million due to increased R&D and equity incentive expenses. The company’s total assets reached over RMB 1 billion with steady growth. Cash flow from operations improved significantly, indicating enhanced liquidity despite profitability challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive R&D capabilities, integrated intelligent power distribution and energy storage solutions, and customized services for major power grid clients. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced technology patents, product stability and compatibility, and the ability to provide one-stop system solutions including hydrogen fuel cells and smart microgrids. The strategic partnership with key shareholders enhances resource access and market expansion.
